Business Loan Frequently Asked Questions

What is the minimum revenue requirement?

SYNTHETIC TEST DATA — NOT ASSESSMENT BUSINESS DATA.

The minimum monthly revenue requirement depends on the loan type. For the Starter business loan, the minimum monthly revenue is $500,000. For the Growth business financing product, the minimum is $1,000,000.

What documents are required?

Applicants must provide business registration, financial statements for the last 2 years, bank statements for the last 6 months, and valid government-issued identification.

What is the processing time?

Standard processing takes 5-7 business days. For amounts over $10,000,000, additional review may extend processing to 14 business days.
